skills.name: Double Sunday
skills.description: 25 Dmg to 2 random enemies | 1 Eng, 1 Rand
skills.notes: Ignores whichever enemy was clicked to fire it -- the actual targets are randomly sampled from the opponent's living team.

skills.name: Shining Friday
skills.description: Destroys any destructible defense, then 40 Piercing Dmg | 2 Rage
skills.notes: remove_defense fires first, so there's nothing left for the piercing hit to absorb into -- the full 40 always lands on HP.

skills.notes: Universal defensive skill (see Goku's afterimage_technique) -- same id/mechanic roster-wide, flavored here to match Piccolo's "Block".
